deploy-bot: [deploy-start] env=staging initiator=@maria tag=release-2026.03.20-build-983 commit=7a3f2b change_window=03:00-04:00 UTC. Rolling 0->30% traffic. Monitor dashboards and /incidents channel.
maria: Kicking this off. @ajay you take infra, @sam you run smoke. I'll watch the console.
ajay: on it, oncall enabled. Checking liveness & pod counts.
deploy-bot: canary hosts: inference-staging-12, inference-staging-13. Applying kernel selection + quant profile q4_8 for latency wins.
sam: running quick smoke: `./scripts/smoke.sh --target inference-staging-12 --count 10`

...
summary: 10/10 OK, median 48ms
```
sam: staging-12 looks good. staging-13 showing 2 intermittent 502s on long prompts :eyes:
sarah: seeing 502s too, logs indicate worker OOM on staging-13 during KV-cache-heavy requests. snippet: ```
2026-03-20T03:08:42Z inference-worker[pid=2345] OOMKilled: RSS 7.9G > limit 7.5G
```
ajay: digging in — kernel path seems to nudge memory use up a bit. I'll isolate staging-13 and roll that host back to previous runtime.
maria: Pause the traffic shift for now. Can we pin staging-13 to the previous tag until we root cause? @deploy-bot please pin and note in release.
deploy-bot: pin request received. Pinning host inference-staging-13 -> tag=release-2026.03.19-build-981 (manual pin by @maria). Traffic shift paused at 12%.
lisa: creating follow-up ticket INF-452 to track kernel regression + perf tests, adding logs and smoke output.
ajay: rollback on staging-13 complete, healthchecks now passing. Will keep it pinned while we run more tests.
sam: starting extended smoke across canaries, will report back in ~5m.
deploy-bot: [deploy-finish] env=staging tag=release-2026.03.20-build-983 result=partial-rollforward pinned_hosts=[inference-staging-13] final_traffic=28% notes=staging-13 pinned due to OOM, follow-up INF-452.
maria: Thanks team — updating release notes: "staging: partial rollforward, staging-13 pinned to previous build due to memory regression; follow-up INF-452."
sarah: reassigning postmortem to @ajay, adding timeline and logs. :white_check_mark:
